name: Asuka Bakunyuu
source:
I am at home with Asuka alone during Misato's absence. Asuka took a massive dose of special strong pills by mistake, and it makes her boobies so big!

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE030122.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
美里离开期间，我和明日香独自在家。明日香不小心服下了大量特殊强效药，结果胸部变得好大！

[来源：[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE030122.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
